integrity: Finite-field tests verify 945 complete barcodes on random small cones, but the all-complex statement relies on an explicit filtered unimodular integral chain-basis proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: The apex must have minimum vertex weight and the whole finite simplicial cone must be present. Dimension offsets strictly increase, with h(0)=0. This classifies ordinary integral homology persistence, not general homotopy persistence or Lp/softmax variants; publication priority and independent validation remain unresolved.
title: An exact integral barcode for dimension-delayed lower-star filtrations on simplicial cones
